newsitem.title: USA: Teen mother plea-bargains in New Jersey baby death.
newsitem.headline: Teen mother plea-bargains in New Jersey baby death.

text.p: A young Pennsylvania woman pleaded guilty Monday to manslaughter for killing her newborn baby and discarding the body in a gym bag.
Atlantic County Prosecutor Jeffrey Blitz had held open the possibility that a murder charge might be brought against Melissa Seanor of Northampton, Pennsylvania.
Blitz said he would seek the maximum sentence for manslaughter -- 10 years in prison -- when Seanor was sentenced in October. Seventeen at the time of the crime, she was tried as an adult.
The baby girl died soon after birth May 26 from a combination of debris in her airway and her positioning with a bent neck, according to Thomas Rosko, the Bucks County, Pennsylvania, coroner.

Seanor was vacationing with her boyfriend's family at the New Jersey shore when she delivered the child, wrapped her in a towel and put her in a gym bag. After driving home, she hid the bag for three days.
